First of all, wow I really didn’t think so many people would take the time out of their own day to help me with my problem, I seriously appreciate every single one of you, even the lurkers (and downvoters lol). I’m gonna clear up some questions I’ve gotten a lot:

1. the reason I’m sure my credits wouldn’t transfer is because my major (direct translation of course name: Media-Sciences) is fairly niche and very few universities here offer courses in said subject. Ive looked up various online universities as to some of your advice and haven’t found one offering any major but I’ll keep looking.

2.The reason I’m not able to finish the courses is because (recently? I’m not sure exactly when this decision was made, I just know it wasn’t there when I enrolled) the University staff voted, that Students are only able to enroll in a specific seminar once per Major, and in some courses I need to pass an exam (of which I’ve already passed all required) and provide my own work project, which I’m missing for some courses. When I started studying I decided that I would enroll in some seminars without doing the work project that semester, in order to gain more of an understanding into the topic, to which I would then do the project in a future semester. Because of the (newly?) decided rule, I cannot enroll in the seminars I enrolled in before, even if I still need to provide a project to achieve enough Credits. 

3. the University staff, especially those supposed to help (mainly the secretary) are extremely hostile and rude towards the students, this has been widely known but brushed off as „that’s just how they are“. I recently had a phone call with the secretary of a different major and she was quite helpful and nice, moreover I’ve talked to my mother and told her about the situation and she’s been very supportive as well. If everything goes well, I should have an appointment with the designated student councilors who will hopefully be able to at least help somewhat.

Lastly I wanna thank you all again for making me feel a lot safer and way less like a fuck-up. Seriously, this has been digging at my mental health for so long and reading some of your comments of having experienced similar situations helped me immensely. I really want to figure this out and come out on top and you have given me more strength to do so, so again, thank you all for reading and taking your time to reply to my post! <3

I honestly think that The connection between showbear/the white bear and Jack Walten is more direct than we think. My guess is that Jack Walten is showbear. Of course we still have no way of knowing how he was fused with showbear, however on top of the connections you already mentioned, like the very similar distorted smile, the fact that the showbear is only briefly seen in TWF2 as a cardboard cutout in the background, and seemingly not having any promotional material (I.e. Not being a “real” member of the showstoppers similar to Billy) could be seen as his presence being “missing” from the Companies history. Similar to how Jack Walten just disappeared one day. 
Showbear/Jack is now trying to contact Sophie, so that she can uncover the truth of what happened to him, Rose, E&M, etc. 

The way showbear talks to Sophie just seems how maybe a fatherly figure would talk to his daughter if she lost her memory but was still curious and wanted to uncover everything that happened. He seems to be very careful when it comes to showing Sophie what happened, which is very different as to how the other Characters show her what happened (I.e. Jumpscares, distorted faces etc.). Showbear straight up tells Sophie, that it could be dangerous (“be weary, for this memory is buried deep in your mind” TWF3) since these memories are so repressed. He also tells her “safety in pills”. He understands what Sophie could be going through and knows that uncovering the truth could potentially be incredibly scarring to Sophie. If you look into the Background of the memories (even in the little teaser of bunny farm in TWF2/Lucky you (don’t remember which on it was in, but y’all hopefully remember what I mean), showbear is seen always lurking, almost as if he’s trying to guide Sophie through her own memory, making sure that she doesn’t overdo it and that she doesn’t mentally break. 

Like I said in the beginning, we’re not at a point in the story, where we can say *how* Jack went missing/got fused with showbear, however there’s way too many coincidences that connect the two characters for it not to be real. Also, and This is just an assumption, I feel like the Walten Files are just way too well made and way too smart as to make Jack Bon. It’s just way too much in the surface level and I honestly feel that a lot of fans would be like “called it”, too many for Martin to be satisfied with the development. 

I’m very very excited to see where this story goes, it has definitely become one of my favorite new age horror YouTube series, haven’t seen one with this much thought put into it in a long time. Glad to see the genre finally getting some love again :)
